defined:
function queue_head(q: record[size: int, empty: bool, elements: list[option[int]]]) -> (head: option[int]) {
    ensure ((q.empty ==>
    (head == None)) ∧
    ((¬ q.empty) ==>
        (is_some(head) ∧
            (∃(i: int) ::
                (((0 <= i < len(q.elements)) ∧
                    (q.elements[i] == head)) ∧
                    (∀(j: int) ::
                        (((0 <= j < len(q.elements)) ∧
                            is_some(q.elements[j])) ==>
                            (unwrap(head) <= unwrap(q.elements[j])))))))));
}
